source_text: The buying rate is 826. 44 yuan for 100 dollars.
corrected_text: The buying rate is 826.44 yuan for 100 dollars.
note: Join the explicitly supplied decimal digits; no exchange-rate value is inferred.

source_text: The buying rate is 826. 44 yuan for 100 dollars.
corrected_text: The buying rate is 826.44 yuan for 100 dollars.
note: The same explicit decimal repair also resolves the former split-number boundary warning.

source_text: It should be due in at 7:30 a. m.tomorrow.
corrected_text: It should be due in at 7:30 a.m. tomorrow.
note: Normalize the explicit clock abbreviation and separate tomorrow; retain 7:30 unchanged.

source_text: Drop it in the mailbox marked out of town.
corrected_text: Drop it in the mailbox marked 'out of town'.
note: The preceding question asks where to post a letter and the next fragment gives the corner. Out of town is the label of the mailbox, not its physical location.

source_text: Finally, she can make notes in shorthand and types and has the skills in report writing, summary writing, keeping minutes at meetings, and so on.
corrected_text: Finally, she can make notes in shorthand and type and has the skills in report writing, summary writing, keeping minutes at meetings, and so on.
note: Can governs make and type. Has starts the separate coordinated statement of skills.

source_text: Then you have to go through the set up procedures.
corrected_text: Then you have to go through the setup procedures.
note: Downloading software is followed by setup procedures. This is the installation noun, not an asserted completed set-up event.

source_text: If I want to make in marking in the advertising industry, I can't stop studying and creating.
corrected_text: If I want to make my mark in the advertising industry, I can't stop studying and creating.
note: In the explicit advertising-career context, the corrupted phrase denotes make my mark. This is a desired achievement under want, never an accomplished action.

source_text: We've settled price, order, payment; now I am calling to ask about package.
corrected_text: We've settled price, order, payment; now I am calling to ask about packaging.
note: The immediately following question asks how to pack goods. The requested topic is packaging, not an individually referenced parcel.

source_text: We got numbers back from our offices in Beijing, Hong Kong, Taipei, Singapore and Tokyo; we're waiting on Bangkok and Kula Lumpur.
corrected_text: We got numbers back from our offices in Beijing, Hong Kong, Taipei, Singapore and Tokyo; we're waiting on Bangkok and Kuala Lumpur.
note: The list of Asian branch offices identifies Kuala Lumpur; correct the misspelled place name only.

source_text: It's hard to say, because the branches are located in diversity different countries; cultural and social influences will definitely play a part in the success of the product in the various markets.
corrected_text: It's hard to say, because the branches are located in diverse countries; cultural and social influences will definitely play a part in the success of the product in the various markets.
note: Different countries is explicitly present; normalize the adjacent erroneous diversity modifier to diverse without introducing a new country or number.

source_text: Train No. 14 leaves at 6:00 p. m, and train No. 22 leaves at 8: 00 p. m.
corrected_text: Train No. 14 leaves at 6:00 p.m., and train No. 22 leaves at 8:00 p.m.
note: Keep both train numbers, both departure times and their coordination; normalize only time spacing.

source_text: Train No. 14 leaves at 6:00 p. m, and train No. 22 leaves at 8: 00 p. m.
corrected_text: Train No. 14 leaves at 6:00 p.m., and train No. 22 leaves at 8:00 p.m.
note: Same two-train departure statement; recheck leaves as a finite predicate after clock normalization.

source_text: Train No. 14 leaves at 6:00 p. m, and train No. 22 leaves at 8: 00 p. m.
corrected_text: Train No. 14 leaves at 6:00 p.m., and train No. 22 leaves at 8:00 p.m.
note: Same two-train departure statement; neither occurrence of Train is an instruction to train.

source_text: It is'www. job. com '
corrected_text: It is 'www.job.com'
note: The reply supplies a website address. Preserve its exact letters and normalize only spacing; no claim that this domain exists.

source_text: They turn up around 4p. m. next Monday, and they check out on next Sunday.
corrected_text: They turn up around 4 p.m. next Monday, and they check out on next Sunday.
note: Normalize the given four o clock p.m. value and keep the separate arrival and departure statements.

source_text: Daily except Sunday at 10,30, 12,20 and 15,10.
corrected_text: Daily except Sunday at 10:30, 12:20 and 15:10.
note: The next question repeats 10:30, confirming the clock separator convention. Preserve all three supplied pairs of digits.

source_text: But we have a policy of paying according to seniority in the company, so new employees get a quite low salary, no matter how excellent they have done.
corrected_text: But we have a policy of paying according to seniority in the company, so new employees get a quite low salary, no matter how excellently they have done.
note: The adverb excellently modifies done. This is a concessive generic condition, not an assertion that a specific worker performed excellently.

source_text: Kobi Bryant and Shaquille O'Neal, they are the Los Angeles Lakers' star players.
corrected_text: Kobe Bryant and Shaquille O'Neal, they are the Los Angeles Lakers' star players.
note: The Lakers player paired with Shaquille O'Neal is unambiguously Kobe Bryant in this dialogue; correct only the first-name spelling.

source_text: She got a master's degree, and now she is going for her doctor.
corrected_text: She got a master's degree, and now she is going for her doctorate.
note: The preceding master's degree makes this an academic doctorate. Going for it expresses pursuit, not attainment.

source_text: Ms. : With a hall pass, you can go to the ladies' room or wherever you need to go during class time.
corrected_text: With a hall pass, you can go to the ladies' room or wherever you need to go during class time.
note: Ms. : is a transcript speaker prefix, not a participant of go. Retain it in the source edit preimage.

source_text: Do you have a hand in locking into the case?
corrected_text: Do you have a hand in looking into the case?
note: Have a hand in looking into the case asks about involvement in investigating the case. The answer Yes confirms involvement, not completion of an investigation.

source_text: I have some trouble with my heart; my doctor recommends I to drink less.
corrected_text: I have some trouble with my heart; my doctor recommends I drink less.
note: The doctor recommends that the speaker drink less. Remove the incompatible infinitive marker while preserving the overt subject and recommendation scope.

source_text: B :: I'm such a fool that duplication of effort is only a waste of time to me.
corrected_text: I'm such a fool that duplication of effort is only a waste of time to me.
note: B :: is a transcript speaker prefix; retain its raw form in provenance, not as a semantic participant.

source_text: I was trembling in the wind when he ran to me with an umbrella in his hand and asked,'Where is your home? '
corrected_text: I was trembling in the wind when he ran to me with an umbrella in his hand and asked, 'Where is your home?'
note: Restore spacing around the quoted question. Asked introduces quoted content; the quotation does not assert a home location.
